customer.dialogue: Wet all the way down, doc. Sorry about the floor. Work needs me jacked in faster. I'm short on cash, but I'll pay what I can. It's not enough. It's never quite enough.

inbox.body:
Ezra Lindqvist mentioned it on the table.

Storm drains under the Sump, dry nine months a year. Stalls on pallets, lamps on wires, and the Undermarket proper behind a curtain of chain. The people who sell you chrome by courier sell it here in person.
inbox.subject: New place: The Flood Tunnels (The Sump)

inbox.body: The lock's fine. Whoever it was knew what they wanted. Open SECURITY on the clinic screen to look into it.
inbox.subject: Break-in: 2 salvaged parts from the bench

inbox.body: Lovely to have you in the building. Popping by later to discuss the arithmetic. — P.O.
inbox.subject: Rent

inbox.body:
Word gets around.

Smelters, presses and a salvage yard that runs three shifts. Arms get caught in machines here every week. The yard sells what the machines spit out: scrap, parts, sometimes chrome still warm.
inbox.subject: New place: Furnace Line Works (Furnace Line)

inbox.body:
Word gets around.

Pre-collapse apartment blocks with working lifts and nosy neighbours. Retired surgeons, old soldiers, families who pay their bills. The old city remembers everyone.
inbox.subject: New place: Caldera Stacks (Old Caldera)

inbox.body: "Mother wants a word. Be nice. She's nice back, mostly."
inbox.subject: Incoming call

inbox.body:
Word gets around.

A members' lounge three floors above the Velvet Tier clubs. Fixers take meetings in the booths; performers come up between sets; someone from Meridian is always slumming. The drinks cost what a stitch costs downstairs.
inbox.subject: New place: The Orchid Room (Velvet Tier)

current.dialogue: Union wants a grip servo on my left arm. Funny thing, doc: my hands haven't shaken since the free clinic van. Nerve tonic, they called it. One shot, no charge. Steady as a crane.
medical_history: Free 'nerve tonic' injection from an outreach van on the Low Line, six weeks ago. No paperwork.

scan_findings.arms: Necrotic patches near the target area. Under the old scar: silver filaments, finer than hair, running along the nerve. Not chrome. Not in any catalogue you own.
scan_findings.head: Tissue within normal range.
